contexts.text: Under Bird, see these references. AC 777. CL 380:4.
The bird divided he not () = spiritual things, and that there are not such parallelism and correspondence... Bird = what is spiritual.

I represented to them the larger and smaller birds of our Earth... When (the Spirits of Mercury) saw these represented birds, they at first wanted to change them, but were afterwards delighted with them, and remained quiet. The reason was that birds signify Knowledges of things.
The middle things of the animal kingdom are called birds and beasts.
